'''Muneo Saitō''' (Japanese: '''斉藤 むねお'''; born: February 15, 1966) is the {{wp|mangaka|manga author}} of the {{pkmn|manga}} series [[Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys]].

He has also worked for [[Game Freak]] as a Pokémon designer since [[Generation II]], with {{p|Raikou}}, {{p|Entei}}, and {{p|Suicune}} as the notable ones. During his playthrough of {{game|Gold and Silver|s}}, he chose {{p|Totodile}} as his [[first partner Pokémon]].

===Generation II and IV===
